title: The Attendance page is never opened by a test
what: No browser test opens Attendance. Checking a member in, removing a check-in, the day picker refusing a future day, the "Nobody matches that" and "Start checking members in" words, the tiles and the losing-the-habit cards are only checked as data, never on the screen the desk uses every morning.
expected: At least one browser test checks a member in and out, picks a future day and an empty register, and reads the tiles and a losing-the-habit card.
fix_line: Add one browser test that drives the Attendance page through check-in, undo, a future day and the empty states

title: The losing-the-habit file download has no test at all
what: No test makes the file of members who are losing the habit. Nothing checks its columns, that it holds exactly the rows on screen, that archived and filtered-out members stay out, that no money column is added, or that mobile numbers keep their digits in a spreadsheet.
expected: A test makes the file from a filtered list and checks the columns, the rows, the mobile numbers and the "Exported N members." message.
fix_line: Add a test for the file: columns, rows equal to the screen, phone digits kept

title: Batches are never seen on screen in any test
what: The batch box, its chips, the "All batches (N)" filter with counts, the "Searching only <batch>" hint on Attendance and "Nobody in this batch" are never opened by a test. Only the batch rules are checked as data.
expected: A browser test adds two members to a batch, picks it in the Members filter and on Attendance, and reads the counts and hints.
fix_line: Add one browser test for the batch chips, the filter and the Attendance hint

title: Bold urgent lines, the Payment label and tapping a browser notice are never checked
what: On Today and in the bell, no test checks that an urgent line still waiting is bold, that a payment line has its own colour and a "Payment" label (so colour is not the only sign), or what opens when a browser notice is tapped. The payment colour is checked only as data.
expected: A test reads the bold and the Payment label on screen and taps a notice to see Today or the alert page open.
fix_line: Add checks for bold, the Payment label and a notice tap to the alerts browser test

title: Sending a message to just one group in the app is never seen on screen
what: The only browser test of Messages uses a server where an app message goes to every member. With a server that sends to a group, the "In the app / Not in the app" line, the "Not in the app" and "Whole group" choices, the empty-group words and the send reaching only that group are checked only as data, so a wrong count or a message to the whole gym would not be caught.
expected: A browser test with group sending on picks a small group, reads the two counts and sends, then checks only that group's app members were in the send.
fix_line: Add a browser test of a group send with a group-capable pretend server

title: Automatic reminders: the offline card and refused saves are never seen on screen
what: No test shows "Automatic reminders need your gym online", a save the server refuses, the "One of the numbers is not allowed" words, the "Days without a check-in" error, "Saving…", or a saved row where only one reminder is damaged.
expected: The reminders browser test also covers an offline gym, a refused save and a damaged saved row.
fix_line: Add the offline, refused and damaged-row cases to the reminders browser test

title: Changing the birthday switch while Today is open is never tested
what: The birthday tests set the switch before the page opens. Nothing checks that Today follows a switch changed on the same visit, that an old answer cannot win over a new save, or that a member whose app number stops matching is suggested again within about 5 minutes. No test does this as front desk.
expected: A test changes the switch and the app list while Today is open and sees the count follow, as owner and as desk.
fix_line: Add a live switch change and a 5-minute recheck to the birthday browser test

title: Two measurement messages are never tested
what: Nothing checks "That entry was deleted on another device. Close this and look again." (the panel could show a raw code instead) or "Note: up to 200 letters." The deleting state is not checked either.
expected: The measurement words test covers the deleted-elsewhere answer and the note limit.
fix_line: Add the not-found and note-limit words to the measurement tests

title: No test checks that a trainer never gets a feedback line
what: The server alert test looks only at questions and complaints for the trainer, and the browser bell test has no feedback line. Nothing would catch a trainer seeing, or being rung for, a member's feedback.
expected: A test gives the gym a feedback alert and checks the trainer's list, bell and notice leave it out.
fix_line: Add a feedback alert to the trainer checks in the server and bell tests
